chunks: From him, from Muḥammad ibn al-Fuḍayl, who said:
I asked a righteous servant, peace be upon him, about the saying of Allah, Mighty and Majestic:
"Those who are heedless of their salat (prayer)."

key_terms.التَّضْيِيعُ: neglecting, wasting, or failing to preserve properly
key_terms.سَاهُونَ: heedless or inattentive in relation to the prayer
key_terms.صَلَاتِهِمْ: their salat (prayer), the prescribed act of worship
key_terms.عَبْدًا صَالِحًا: a righteous servant, a reverential designation for the Imam عليه السلام
key_terms.قَوْلِ اللَّهِ: the statement of Allah in the Qur'an

ai.seo_question: What does "those who are heedless of their salat" mean in the Qur'an?
ai.summary: This hadith explains the Qur'anic phrase about being heedless of salat (prayer) as referring to neglecting it. The emphasis is not merely on momentary forgetfulness, but on allowing the prayer to be wasted or not properly maintained.
